name: Feather Fall
description:
Choose up to five falling creatures within medium range. Roll Lore against a difficulty of 10 + the number of chosen creatures.

On a pass, each affected creature’s descent slows to a controlled pace, allowing them to land safely and on their feet. This effect lasts for one minute.

On a failure, their fall is only partially slowed. If a creature lands before the spell ends, it takes half the normal falling damage.

Describe how you slow the fall.
successes:
✨: All affected creatures are able to guide their movement as they fall, moving up to half their speed horizontally.

🌞: All affected creatures stop falling immediately. While the spell lasts, they may move through the air in any direction they choose except upward.

💀: The spell misfires: it does not slow falling at all and pushes each target 15 feet away from you. Check a condition.

improvements.name: Precious Cargo
improvements.description: You may also target objects with this spell. Each object must weigh 300 lbs or less.
